geometry_method.crop: alpha > 8 native bounding box, padded by 3 px; source bytes unchanged
geometry_method.contact: centroid of alpha > 96 pixels in bottom ceil(1.5% of alpha bbox height) rows
geometry_method.baseline: exclusive lower alpha > 8 bound, corresponding to lowest boot edge
geometry_method.heightRatio: (padded crop height / stance padded crop height) × (stance ochre helmet width / pose ochre helmet width); measured helmet colors within visually inspected top ROI; preserves apparent head/helmet width with uniform scaling
geometry_method.visualReview: All generated native poses inspected; optical pose shape and same face/costume checked. No browser/native Canvas scene review.

contact_measurement_extension: per-row alpha>96 counts and pixel-center sums; bottom 1.5% bbox band; restricted RGB helmet paint measurement for head scale
limitations: The costume identity comes from this project's old Viaduc sprites, not an official reference costume.
The human face comes from the project's newly generated and inspected Mama Atelier portrait.
No browser, local filesystem, native Canvas scene validation or official-source 1:1 certification performed.
Single poses do not constitute full frame-by-frame animation.

assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one native transparent PNG character sprite for a side-view fighting game, portrait 1024x1536 composition. Primary request: replace the simplified articulated figure from image 2 with the detailed HUMAN Mama from image 1, wearing the project's existing 'Maintenance du viaduc' alternate costume. Image 1 is ONLY the human face/identity and realistic materials reference. Image 2 is ONLY the outfit, colors, accessories and ready-pose reference; ignore its flat mannequin style and horizontal background streaks. This is an existing fan-game maintenance outfit, not a claim of an official costume. Lock Mama's slender adult face, blue-grey eyes, dark brows, fine round wire-frame glasses and dark brown hair, gathered in a compact tie/bun under the helmet. Exact outfit invariants from image 2: ochre-yellow industrial safety helmet with small cyan front lamp and dark rim; light grey sleeveless work top with natural human shoulders/arms; diagonal ochre safety strap with dark webbing/buckles; small ochre-edged shoulder guard; grey-beige cargo trousers with sewn pockets and cloth folds; dark knee pads bordered in ochre; dark grey practical ankle work boots; dark forearm tool cuffs with small cyan indicators; one circular cable reel on the visible hip. Hold the compact dark handheld scanner/tool with its orange inset in her forward hand. No gun, no baby, no extra Odradek, no added backpack. Pose: full body combat-ready neutral stance, facing RIGHT in a readable side/very slight three-quarter view, upright head and torso, feet separated but stable on a shared baseline, knees slightly flexed, both elbows bent with hands and tool in front of her torso. Natural human anatomy and skin, not a robot or mannequin. Art: highly detailed game-character 3D render matching image 1, soft neutral lighting, sharply readable fabrics, worn metal and realistic face. Complete helmet, hands and BOTH boots visible, generous transparent margins on every side. Exactly ONE character, no montage, no lettering, no background, no floor, no cast ground shadow, no blur, no horizontal streaks. Actual alpha transparency. Preserve warm yellow/grey/cyan maintenance identity.
